# ActionAmp

> A focus app that opens to one task — the next thing that matters — not a list.

ActionAmp is a focus app built on a simple bet: the problem isn't capturing
tasks, it's deciding which one to do next. Every other todo app helps you write
things down. None of them help you pick. The home screen is a chooser, not a
list. ADHD is the design muse, not the marketing target.

## Product

- [ActionAmp — landing page](https://actionamp.com/): the whole pitch in one scroll. What it is, how it works, why it exists.
- [About](https://actionamp.com/about): the thesis — why focus apps optimize capture and nobody optimizes the decision.
- [Roadmap](https://actionamp.com/roadmap): what's shipped, what's next, in priority order.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://actionamp.com/blog/): essays on focus, decisions, and doing the next thing. Two streams — Finds (short curated pointers) and Essays (long-form).
- [Why the list is the problem, not the answer](https://actionamp.com/blog/why-the-list-is-the-problem/): the core thesis essay. Every todo app optimizes capture. None optimize the decision.
- [The capture trap](https://actionamp.com/blog/the-capture-trap/): writing things down feels like progress. It isn't. Capture is free; the decision is what costs.
- [Working memory is the real bottleneck](https://actionamp.com/blog/working-memory-is-the-bottleneck/): you have four slots, not ninety-seven. What executive-function research says about prioritization.
- [A calm GTD setup in 15 minutes](https://actionamp.com/blog/a-calm-gtd-setup-in-15-minutes/): inbox, triage, one goal, one project, one task. The minimum viable system.
- [RSS feed](https://actionamp.com/rss.xml): all published posts, both streams.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://actionamp.com/guides/): practical, short systems for choosing what matters next.
- [Choose your next task](https://actionamp.com/guides/choose-next-task/): choose one doable next action when everything feels important.
- [Task lists are necessary. Living inside them is not.](https://actionamp.com/guides/task-lists-are-necessary/): keep commitments accounted for without showing every commitment all day.
- [Use a notebook and ActionAmp together](https://actionamp.com/guides/notebook-and-actionamp/): paper for thinking; ActionAmp for commitments and next actions.
